title: GTM CS 1:1 prep - Samira Patel & Aaron Li (2026-03-20)
body:
Purpose: quick sync ahead of Q2 renewal review + unblock technical rollout. Keep to 30 min.

Agenda (30m):
- 5m: Quick personal check-in / priorities this week
- 10m: ACME Corp status update (health, adoption, blockers)
- 8m: Renewal conversation prep / negotiation levers
- 5m: Action items + owners / next check-in

NOTES / CONTEXT:
- Renewal: ACME scheduled for 2026-05-15 (contract ends). Current ARR: $220k. Upsell opp for +$60k (usage-based). Renewal owner: Aaron (lead), Samira (CS lead).
- Health score: 66 (down from 74 last month). Decline driven by recent latency spike and 2 missed SLOs in late Feb.
- Recent incidents: 2026-02-27 outage (partial region failover) — Root cause: autoscaler misconfig + config drift; SRE ticket created (SRE-187).
- Current open technical asks:
  * Feature: per-tenant KV cache retention control (ACME asked for 90d) — Product PRD in draft (link in Confluence).
  * Integration: SE deep-dive to finish charting ingestion pipeline (scheduled but not yet done).
- Billing: invoicing discrepancy for Feb (overcharged by ~$3.2k) — billing ticket: FIN-304 (priority to reconcile before renewal convo).

Talking points for Aaron:
- Acknowledge the outage and steps taken (SRE postmortem scheduled, improved autoscaler guardrails). Empathy + concrete timeline for fixes.
- Push the value conversation: recent ROI from reduced per-token cost after batching config + observed latency improvements for two routes. Bring usage numbers (see `ACME_usage_Mar.csv` in Drive).
- Use the billing discrepancy as a short-term ask: confirm we will credit the Feb overcharge and show a reconciled invoice before renewal discussion.
- For upsell: propose a staged Dedicated capacity pilot (3 months) with committed throughput guarantee — reduces per-token cost and gives predictability. Suggest a special pilot discount to lower friction.

Open questions to resolve before 1:1 with Aaron:
- Who on SRE is the point for the KV cache retention feature? (action: Samira -> ping Maya to identify owner)
- Can Finance issue provisional credit for Feb overcharge before renewal meeting? (action: Aaron -> follow up with Emma in Finance)
- Do we have the usage-by-route CSV for Mar (needed to model cost savings)? If not, request CEP to run export. (action: Samira)

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Samira: Pull Mar usage report (by route + token type) and prepare 1-slide summary for renewal (due 2026-03-22).
- Aaron: Email Emma (Finance) to request provisional credit note for Feb billing discrepancy, cc Samira (due 2026-03-21).
- Samira: Schedule SE deep-dive with ACME infra team and SE (Kevin) — propose slots 2026-03-24 or 03-25 (due 2026-03-21).
- Samira: Add incident postmortem link and SRE mitigations to renewal pack (due 2026-03-23).
- Aaron + Samira: Draft renewal negotiation playbook (list of levers & thresholds: discount bands, pilot options, committed throughput levels) — first draft by 2026-03-26.
- Max (cc): Follow up on playbook template + previous winning renewal scripts (Samira to loop Max in).

Prep deliverables to bring to the meeting:
- 1-slide health + usage summary (Samira)
- Short list of product asks + status (Samira)
- Proposed pilot terms + discount band (Aaron)
- Reconciled invoice status (Finance)

Risks / Escalations:
- If SRE mitigation timeline slips >2 weeks, risk of churn increases — consider temporary credit or SLA concession to preserve relationship.
- Product deliverable (KV cache retention) is not in roadmap this quarter; need to decide whether to commit to timeline for ACME or offer alternate mitigation (config workaround).

Notes to self (Samira):
- Keep tone collaborative; acknowledge pain points, lead with fixes and concrete next steps.
- Use data, not promises: have usage numbers and before/after perf samples ready.
- Avoid long-term price commitments in first renewal convo — focus on pilot with committed throughput.

Follow-ups after meeting (to be recorded here):
- Update: credit issued by Finance (date)
- Update: SE deep-dive scheduled (date/time)
- Update: Draft renewal playbook accepted and shared with sales leadership

Quick links: ACME Confluence: /pages/acme-onboarding | Jira: ACME-42 | Slack: #acct-acme | Drive: /shared_drives/customer-success/acme/renewal-pack-2026

Scratch notes / things to ask Aaron live:
- "What internal signals are they watching to sign the renewal?"
- "Who else at ACME should we bring into the pilot conversation?"
- "If we offer a two-month reduced price pilot, is that sufficient runway to show value?"

---
End of prep.
